CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Monarchy in Israel: King David? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Monarchy in Israel: King David.
   B. Use Monarchy in Israel: King David to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Monarchy in Israel: King David with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Monarchy in Israel: King David has no place in daily life.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Study Methods Devotional Method? (1 mark)
   A. Use Bible Study Methods Devotional Method to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Bible Study Methods Devotional Method with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Study Methods Devotional Method.
   D. Say Bible Study Methods Devotional Method has no place in daily life.

3. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

4. Which response best shows understanding of Monarchy in Israel: King Solomon? (1 mark)
   A. Say Monarchy in Israel: King Solomon has no place in daily life.

   C. Use Monarchy in Israel: King Solomon to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Monarchy in Israel: King Solomon with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

6. Which response best shows understanding of Prophet Hosea? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Prophet Hosea.
   B. Apply the teaching of Prophet Hosea with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

   D. Say Prophet Hosea has no place in daily life.

7. Which response best shows understanding of : 1Peter Selected teachings? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of : 1Peter Selected teachings with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing : 1Peter Selected teachings.
   C. Use : 1Peter Selected teachings to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say : 1Peter Selected teachings has no place in daily life.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Restoration of Judah: Nehemiah? (1 mark)
   A. Use Restoration of Judah: Nehemiah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Restoration of Judah: Nehemiah has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Restoration of Judah: Nehemiah.
   D. Apply the teaching of Restoration of Judah: Nehemiah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Which response best shows understanding of General Epistle: James? (1 mark)
   A. Say General Epistle: James has no place in daily life.
   B. Use General Epistle: James to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing General Epistle: James.
   D. Apply the teaching of General Epistle: James with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Schism and Syncretism in Israel? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Schism and Syncretism in Israel with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Schism and Syncretism in Israel.
   C. Say Schism and Syncretism in Israel has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Schism and Syncretism in Israel to insult classmates of other faiths.

11. Which response best shows understanding of : 1Peter Selected teachings ● Christian Suffering/ Persecution ● Good Stewards o? (1 mark)
   A. Use : 1Peter Selected teachings ● Christian Suffering/ Persecution ● Good Stewards o to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing : 1Peter Selected teachings ● Christian Suffering/ Persecution ● Good Stewards o.

   D. Say : 1Peter Selected teachings ● Christian Suffering/ Persecution ● Good Stewards o has no place in daily life.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Biblical Stewardship? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Biblical Stewardship.

   C. Use Biblical Stewardship to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Biblical Stewardship has no place in daily life.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain General Epistle: James and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain : 1Peter Selected teachings and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain : 1Peter Selected teachings ● Christian Suffering/ Persecution ● Good Stewards o and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Unity of Believers and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
